snippet.title: Metal Undergrowth - A small atmospheric game about collecting weird creatures!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://kenforest.itch.io/metal-undergrowth?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A small atmospheric game set in a strange, overgrown superstructure. It’s inhabited by peculiar hybrid creatures that you can collect to buy upgrades and repair your transport capsule — your only way to escape (or not).
